name: boxhead-2play-rooms-remake
description: 1:1 remake of Boxhead: 2Play Rooms (Sean Cooper, 2007) in TypeScript + Canvas2D + Electron

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.strict.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run extract -- --if-stale && node tools/make-icon.ts && npm run typecheck && vite build && node tools/build-electron.ts

author: Boxhead remake (fan project; original game by Sean Cooper)
